description: This file contains functions for ranking, deduplicating, and processing code snippets for autocomplete suggestions, including similarity calculations and prompt filling.

methods.name: getSymbolsForSnippet
methods.description: Extracts a set of symbols from a code snippet by splitting on special characters.

methods.name: jaccardSimilarity
methods.description: Calculates similarity between two snippets based on shared symbols.

methods.name: rankAndOrderSnippets
methods.description: Ranks snippets based on similarity to the cursor context and sorts them.

methods.name: deduplicateSnippets
methods.description: Merges overlapping snippets from the same file into single ranges.

methods.name: mergeSnippetsByRange
methods.description: Merges overlapping snippets within a file based on their range positions.

methods.name: mergeOverlappingRangeContents
methods.description: Combines contents of overlapping snippets into a single string.

methods.name: fillPromptWithSnippets
methods.description: Selects snippets to fill the prompt within token limits, prioritizing higher scored snippets.
